programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fult Spel i Hejaklacken
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när bara en av dem blir uttagen till cheerleader-laget. Max vinner en tävling där priset är en månads gratis pizza, och måste övertyga sin familj att han inte fuskade.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thunder-Van
programme.desc: Hank tar hem familjens Thunder-Van från Metroburg för att Phoebe ska kunna fortsätta sin superhjälteträning. När alla fyra barnen smyger sig in i bilen för att utan lov ta en tur ger Hank dem en åktur de aldrig kommer att glömma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Konsten att Sälja Konst
programme.desc: Phoebe får hjälp av Billy med ett konstprojekt, men får veta att han stulit föremålet från ett museum. Nu måste de samarbeta med Max för att ta sig in och lämna tillbaka det innan någon märker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Max hejdukar
programme.desc: Max låter några yngre elever bli hans hejdukar, men när de vänder på situationen och gör honom till offer för ett förödmjukande skämt, måste han tänka ut ett sätt att återta positionen som skolans värsting.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Jobbiga Föräldrar
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max är irriterade över familjens regler och använder en av Max apparater för att få Hank och Barb att bete sig som tonåringar. Men att då få ta över ansvaret som föräldrar får tonåringarna att ångra sig.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Strimligt
programme.desc: Phoebe blir förkrossad när hon tror att familjens nya dokumentförstörare av misstag förstört hennes konsertbiljetter till MKTO. I själva verket har Max tagit dem för att bjuda sin nya kärlek på konserten. Gästartister: Sidney Park och MKTO.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe Rockar
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker bli en tuff tjej för att imponera på Max nya bästa vän, en tuff rocker och frontfigur i Max nya band. Gästartist: Lizzie Green.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Dag i Gallerian
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max förvandlar en enkel tur till gallerian för att hämta Hanks födelsedagspresent till slagsmål, kaos och en kontrovers med vakten som hotar att förstöra deras pappas födelsedag.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det Stora Fiaskot
programme.desc: Max vill försöka vinna en tävling för mest misslyckade video med en 'misslyckad' video med Phoebe när hon övar balett. När Phoebe får veta hans plan vägrar hon att samarbeta och Max tar till desperata åtgärder för att få de bilder han vill ha.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Vänner För Alltid
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max oroar sig för att de ska behöva umgås för jämnan när deras vänner börjar hänga med varandra. Syskonen tar till fula knep för att se till att det blir pinsamt för alla när de går på bio.

programme.title: South Park: Geggfolk
programme.desc: South Park översvämmas av arbetare från framtiden som tar alla jobben för lägre löner. Männen i South Park går förvånansvärt långt för att stoppa dem.

programme.title: South Park: Korns svängiga piratspökemysterium

programme.title: South Park: SHOTS!!!

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Tjejer. Del 2
programme.desc: Henrys planer inför den stora skolfesten blir lite komplicerade när han även måste gå på festen som Kid Danger. När det sedan börjar köra ihop sig rejält på festen tvingas han ta ett drastiskt beslut.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence

programme.title: Klovn: Den Japanska Trädgården
programme.desc: Casper och Iben ska gifta sig i Thailand, på åtta meters djup, så vännerna håller på att ta dykarcertifikat. Frank är stolt över rollen som best man men det trasslar till sig när han ska hjälpa Casper att klara upp sitt förflutna med Signe Lindkvist.

programme.title: Klovn: Trollkarlen Från Frederiksberg
programme.desc: Casper har blivit inbjuden till en prestigefylld orden men det finns ingen plats för Frank, till hans stora besvikelse. Men eftersom han skrivit en Sagan om ringen-analogi om politik blir han i alla fall inbjuden till en grupp lajvare.

programme.title: Klovn: Hör På Nu, Frank
programme.desc: Frank och Mia ska åka till Kina men han oroar sig över att Muffi ska vara med Morten Olsens hund. Casper och Frank har börjat fäktas och här går snacket om impotens och Viagra.

programme.title: Klovn
programme.desc: Frank fyller 40 och det ska firas på Hotel Josty. Casper har varit hans bästa vän i 11 år och ska vara toastmaster. Men det blir konstig stämning när han i sitt tal erbjuder sperma så att Mia och Frank kan få barn.

programme.title: Klovn: Muffen Fäller
programme.desc: Det lackar mot jul och Mia och Frank ger varandra adventskalender-presenter. Frank får ett par skridskor och orsakar tumult på skridskobanan. Det blir också ett och annat obekvämt besök på kemtvätten.

programme.title: Klovn: Surprise Mia
programme.desc: Iben och Casper ska på brittiska filmgalan BAFTA och hon har med alla sina Louis Vuitton-väskor. Mia tvivlar på Franks kärlek och tänker att han hellre vill vara ihop med någon kändis, så han planerar en överraskning för henne.

programme.title: Klovn: Gotteligott
programme.desc: Casper är deppig och ligger mest i sin säng. Frank köper en videokamera för att muntra upp honom men Casper tycker inte att det händer något värt att filma. Samtidigt blir det stort drama i Mias butik och kameran är nyckeln till allt.

programme.title: Klovn: Shut Up
programme.desc: När Mias butik blir rättvisemärkt träffar Frank en fängslande kvinna. Men raggningsförsöket slutar i att han och Mia får husera en tibetansk flykting. Casper är deprimerad och tycker att han inte får cred för att han hjälpt komikerkollegor.

programme.title: Klovn: De Flätade Skorna Och Ägget
programme.desc: Mia vill skaffa en ny stol men Frank tycker inte att de ska lägga pengar på dyra möbler. Han vill hellre investera i en gräsklippare som ska delas med grannen. När Frank träffar en norsk tjej råkar han utge sig för att vara Muhammed-tecknare.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings

programme.title: Key & Peele: Parole Officer Puppet
programme.desc: En övervakare använder en docka för att knyta an till en villkorligt frigiven, en man med nackstöd försöker festa loss och en soldat har en känslosam återförening med sin familj.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting
programme.desc: En gangster försöker desperat att visa att han är "loco", terrorister träffas för att planera sitt nästa drag och en avundsjuk bror gör familjemiddagen pinsam.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En footballspelare med hjärnskakning försöker inspirera sitt lag, en man anklagar sin fru för att vara otrogen med en hund och en restaurangägare skrämmer bort sina gäster.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Vi får se en footballspelare straffas för överdrivet firande, Jordan och Keegan gå på premiären av 'Othello' och en high school-elev som blir känd efter att ha stulit ett skämt från en klasskamrat.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: En kille jagar sin tjej till världens ände och LMFAO kan bokstavligen inte sluta partaja.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan och Keegan spelar två mystiker som kämpar om ensamrätten att få ge kloka råd. Dessutom ser vi när Jaden Smith diskuterar ett nytt manus med sin agent och när ett gaypar 'firar' den nya äktenskapslagen.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Special

programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: CBS Morning News
programme.desc: Join Errol Barnett for the CBS Morning News weekdays at 7AM ET. Featuring the latest breaking news, in depth original reporting and news making interviews plus all the big stories impacting Americans from coast to coast.

programme.title: CBS Mornings
programme.desc: Reporting on international news stories, interviews, and in-depth pieces, covering topics from news, sports, climate and technology to race, health, parenting and personal finance.

programme.title: CBS News 24/7 Mornings
programme.desc: Se på CBS News, dygnet runt och följ de senaste världstäckande nyheterna med spännade reportage och heta diskussioner.

programme.title: CBS News 24/7
programme.desc: Coverage, reporting and storytelling from CBS News and Stations; a look at how news coverage comes together.

programme.title: On the Case: Taken
programme.desc: In the span of 8 months, 3 young girls are kidnapped from their homes and murdered. When their killer strikes again a young girl's heroic actions solves the case.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Omen
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the disturbing disappearance case of a teenager who vanished without a trace from a cinema car park.

programme.title: On the Case: In Plain Sight
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman is murdered the evidence points detectives to a killer hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Bird Key
programme.desc: A successful business man is found brutally murdered in his palatial Southern Florida home. A mysterious backpack found at the crime scene is the key to the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Kidnapped on the 4th of July
programme.desc: When a young woman's pizza delivery car is found abandoned in the middle of the desolate stretch of road, a twenty three year mystery begins.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Carnage
programme.desc: When 25 year old Laci Hill vanishes without a trace; police receive the key to solving the mystery from her kidnapper's wife.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Laurence Dromard Case
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want her dead.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)
programme.desc: On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. She made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.desc: Efter att ha blivit hemkallad av sin åldriga skapare råkar Data i luven på sin elaka bror Lore.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: En holodäckfantasi går snett och skickar Worf och hans son till en västernkraftmätning med en bov som exakt liknar Data.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Carnage
programme.desc: When 25 year old Laci Hill vanishes without a trace; police receive the key to solving the mystery from her kidnapper's wife.

programme.title: On the Case: A Drop of Blood
programme.desc: A single mother is murdered at work. Will a single drop of blood lead police to her killer?

programme.title: On the Case: A Nightmare in Laurel
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears before her final shift at a Maryland hospital, her family begins a decades-long search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Evil Repeats Itself
programme.desc: Beautiful teenager Mary Jayne Jones is found murdered in a desolate farmhouse while its owner is out of town.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Call
programme.desc: When bartender Anita Andrews is stabbed to death inside her family's bar, police conclude her killer was the last patron she served that night.

programme.title: On the Case: Shortcut to Murder
programme.desc: Paula Zahn goes beyond the headlines in search of fascinating mysteries from within America's justice system. A shortcut home from school causes a 14-year-old girl to cross paths with a murderer.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Quite a Spectacle
programme.desc: It was one of the most unusual cases in forensic history. Investigators had to find a way to solve a murder case using only a squashed tomato found at the crime scene and tiny, pinpoint reflections of light in a photograph.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Transaction Failed
programme.desc: When a dedicated, well-respected teacher disappeared, police had to determine if she'd gone on vacation without telling anyone or if she was the victim of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Day the Music Died
programme.desc: Seattle police had no suspects in the violent murder of grunge singer Mia Zapata. More than a decade passed before evidence collected by a prescient medical examiner could be used by forensic scientists to identify the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Survivor
programme.desc: A Michigan State University grad student disappeared and was presumed dead. With the help of a professor of geological sciences, police hoped to get the "dirt" on her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: On the Case: Shortcut to Murder
programme.desc: Paula Zahn goes beyond the headlines in search of fascinating mysteries from within America's justice system. A shortcut home from school causes a 14-year-old girl to cross paths with a murderer.

programme.title: On the Case: Secrets From The Grave
programme.desc: After a teenager's partially nude body is discovered brutally beaten in a desolate cemetery, Investigators and her family face an emotional journey to the truth behind her murder

programme.title: On the Case: Blurred Truth
programme.desc: Paula Zahn explores a chilling crime mystery involving a murdered mother of five and speaks to the individuals directly involved in the case

programme.title: On the Case: Followed Home
programme.desc: A mother of three is found shot to death inside the trunk of her car, just steps from her home.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer Among Friends
programme.desc: When a teenager is found savagely murdered, police must retrace her last steps alive to identify her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programme.desc: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Audrey Jouannet Case
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.
